operations.verify: pnpm run source:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:runtime && pnpm run test:gauge && pnpm run check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: pause writes and scheduled work; retain source, private settings and an export; restore into fresh empty resources with unchanged migration names and bytes; establish a fresh owner and verify records, attachments and re-export before routing traffic.
